label: Figure 9.6: Measures to reduce consumption of e-cigarettes (negative externality)
alt: E-cigarette market showing a tax shifting MSC up to MSC plus tax and a campaign shifting MPB left, both reaching Q*.
caption: Starting from Figure 9.5, two policies cut output from Q1 = 70 to the efficient Q* = 50 million packs. 1. Tax: an $8 per-pack tax shifts supply up to MSC + tax, which cuts MPB at Q*; consumers now pay Pt = $22 (above P1 = $18) and the government collects $8 × 50 = $400 million. 2. Campaign: reduces private demand, shifting MPB left towards MSB so it meets the original MSC at Q*.
